action_items.change: With the hinge bias now 4-9 deg, static and slowly moving arms show de-biased elbow bends of 5-20 deg, right inside the 2-10 deg window where the upper-arm twist weight goes 0 -> 1. The twist then snaps by 20-40 deg in 1-2 frames. Widen the window (zero ~15, full ~35 deg, as in v1 A5) and/or low-pass the twist weight; a nearly straight arm should inherit its twist smoothly.

action_items.area: depth sign still flips when the tracker is 'confident'
action_items.change: Sign continuity only applies while |tracker dz| < 0.3 L. When the tracker itself flips with a large depth (arms crossing in 0663, kick in df1e), the rebuilt joint still jumps 36-47 cm in one frame. Keep the previous sign unless the opposite sign persists for >= 3 frames, or choose the whole sign sequence per segment by dynamic programming (cost = depth jump + joint-limit violation, e.g. elbow/knee bending backwards).
